description:
Job Description:
 • Develop, implement, and maintain Internet/intranet applications using modern web application frameworks and server side scripting languages.
 • Import, manipulate and display data from heterogeneous sources. Such as:
 • XML Files, Databases, flat files, SOAP, REST
 • Deliver ergonomic, efficient and consistent user interfaces.
 • Diagnose, troubleshoot and support internally developed web applications.
 • Establish and document departmental programming standards.
 • Define, document and conduct Software Development Lifecycle tasks to include:
 • Requirements Gathering
 • Application architecture diagrams
 • Design Documents
 • Test cases
 • Continuous Integration
 • Bug Tracking
 • Consult with various internal and external business units and partners on software development and design:
 • Data Interface Protocols
 • Managing Data Integrity
 • Managing Data Security
 • Mentor co-workers to improve their skills and proficiency.
 • Recognize and suggest opportunities for improvement in all aspects of the job.
 • Will require occasional after-hours work and after-hours on-call duties.
 


 Skills & Qualifications:
 

 • PHP Programming experience required.
 

 • HTML, JavaScript, AJAX and CSS required.
 

 • Client side JavaScript framework library experience preferred. (jQuery, Backbone)
 

 • UNIX/Linux system administration experience
 

 • Ability to learn new web frameworks and scripting languages quickly.
 

 • Additional Programming/Scripting languages desired: PERL, Python, C#, Java, C, C++
 

 • SharePoint development experience
 

 • Database experience preferred: Oracle, MySQL, MSSQL, Informix, sqlite
 

 • Excellent diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.
 

 • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
 

 • Must be detail oriented and self-managing.
 

 • Bachelor Degree with an emphasis in Information Systems or Computer Science preferred

 Shibu Thomas
 408-724-9766
